title-screen.alt: The title screen on a near-black background with faint blue stars. "Pattern Break" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a row of small LED segments shading from green to red. Below it, a menu in small pixel type: "Play" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Practice" with "The_Epic_Chip", "Difficulty" with "Normal", "Jukebox", "Controls", "Help" and "Settings", in grey. Under the menu, "Music: The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain."
title-screen.caption: The title menu. Not used in the README.

jukebox.alt: "Jukebox" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow over a starfield. Below it, a list of nine songs in grey pixel type with their authors right-aligned in dim grey: The_Epic_Chip, Numen in Da Chip, FastLane, CHiP_OVERTURE, The_Dim_Dungeon, 4_RNDD!, Girl From Mars, Wrath_of_the_Djinn and Keygen 9000, then "Back". The first song is lime with an amber ">" before it. Under the list, a dim row of 24 LED bars, green at the bottom to red at the top, all unlit. At the bottom, "The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain." in grey and "0:12 / 3:48" in cyan.
jukebox.caption: The jukebox, playing the first song. Not used in the README.

controls-keyboard.alt: "Controls" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow. Below it, a drawing of a keyboard: dark keycaps with dim labels, and the keys the game uses filled in colour. Esc is grey; W, A, S, D and the four arrow keys to the right are white; Space, Z and J are cyan; X and K amber; C and L magenta; V and ; red; F and ' lime; both Shift keys violet. Under it, a legend in two columns, a coloured square before each action: Fly, Arrows, WASD; Fire, Space, Z, J; Bomb, X, K; Missile, C, L; Nuke, V, ;; Buy, F, '; Boost, Shift; Pause, Esc. At the bottom, "< Keyboard  Gamepad >" with "Keyboard" in cyan.
controls-keyboard.caption: The controls screen, keyboard page. Not used in the README.

controls-gamepad.alt: "Controls" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow. Below it, a drawing of a gamepad: a dark body with a grip under each end, a white D-pad on the left, a white ring for the left stick and a dim one for the right, two small buttons in the middle with "Start" under the right one, and four round face buttons: Y lime at the top, X red on the left, B amber on the right, A cyan at the bottom. Above the body, shoulder buttons: LT and LB violet on the left, RT cyan and RB magenta on the right. Under it, a legend in two columns: Fly, Stick, D-pad; Fire, A, RT; Bomb, B; Missile, RB; Nuke, X; Buy, Y; Boost, LB, LT; Pause, Start. At the bottom, "< Keyboard  Gamepad >" with "Gamepad" in cyan.
controls-gamepad.caption: The controls screen, gamepad page. Not used in the README.

help.alt: "Help" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a list with a grey scroll bar on the right, its thumb at the top. Cyan section names, then rows of an icon, a white label and a value on the right. Enemies: the magenta ship sprite, Ship, 100 in amber; the turret, Turret, 200; the lime tank, "Tank 3 hits", 300; the magenta bullet, Bullet, "Dodge" in grey. Score: an amber "200", "Kill on the beat", x2; an amber "x2", "10 kills no hit", "+1 Max x4"; the cyan player ship, "Life left at end", 1000; the amber nuke icon, "10 beat kills", "+1 Nuke Max 3". Weapons: a cyan dash, Shot, "Hold fire" in grey.
help.caption: The help screen at its top. Not used in the README.

help-end.alt: The help screen scrolled to its end, the scroll bar thumb at the bottom. Rows of an icon, a white label and a grey value: a small angled cyan shot, Double, "Angled shot"; a white bar, Laser, "Pierces"; the missile, Missile, "Air to air"; the cyan drone orb, Drone, "Copies fire Max 2"; the player ship inside a cyan ring, Shield, "3 hits"; no icon, "Life lost", "Upgrades lost" in magenta. Then the cyan section name Display: the player ship, Lives, "3 to start"; the amber bomb icon, "Bomb ready", Fills; the missile icon, "Missile ready", Fills; an amber "x3", Multiplier; the amber nuke icon, "Nukes held".
help-end.caption: The help screen scrolled to its end. Not used in the README.

settings.alt: "Settings" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow. Below it, three rows in small pixel type. "Music" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "<", five LED cells lit green, yellow-green, yellow, orange and red, and ">". "Effects" in grey with four of its five cells lit and the fifth dim red. "Back" in grey.
settings.caption: The settings screen at the default volumes. Not used in the README.

hangar-walk.alt: A hangar in shades of grey: a dark back wall with steel girders, a row of roof trusses, and three hanging work lights casting faint cones onto a grey floor marked with a dashed line. On the right, a grey fighter jet faces right on two landing struts over hazard stripes, its canopy raised open and a ladder leaning against its side. On the left, a small pilot in a white helmet with a dark visor walks towards it.
hangar-walk.caption: The hangar intro: the captain walks to the fighter. Not used in the README.

hangar-climb.alt: The same grey hangar, closer in on the fighter. The pilot, in a white helmet, is near the top of the ladder against the fuselage, just below the open canopy and the dark cockpit opening.
hangar-climb.caption: The hangar intro: the captain climbs the ladder. Not used in the README.

hangar-cockpit.alt: Inside the cockpit, in shades of grey. Through the open canopy at the top, the dark hangar wall and its girders. Below, the instrument panel: a row of small indicator lights, two round gauges, and in the middle a cassette deck with a dark window and five keys under it: rewind, play, fast forward, stop and eject. A gloved hand on a dark sleeve reaches in from the right holding a light grey cassette labelled "Numen in Da Chip", half way into the deck.
hangar-cockpit.caption: The hangar intro: the cassette goes into the deck. Not used in the README.

hangar-play.alt: The cockpit with the cassette "Numen in Da Chip" in the deck window. Above the panel, "Level 1" in large white pixel letters, "by JAM. Public Domain." and "Normal" in grey. The gloved hand presses the Play key, which sits lower than the others.
hangar-play.caption: The hangar intro: Play pressed. Not used in the README.

hangar-clip.alt: Eight seconds in shades of grey. A pilot walks across a hangar to a fighter jet with its canopy open, climbs the ladder as the view closes in on the cockpit, and drops into the seat. The view cuts to the instrument panel: a gloved hand slides a cassette labelled "Numen in Da Chip" into the deck, "Level 1", the credit and "Normal" appear above the panel, and the hand comes back and presses Play, and the cassette reels start to turn.
hangar-clip.caption: The hangar intro from the start to Play. Not used in the README.

run-start.alt: The start of level 1. In the top quarter of the screen, through the cockpit glass, the LED cavern with its columns in pale, washed-out greens and the HUD: three ship icons and a bomb icon on the left, the score on the right. Under it, a dark canopy frame with a light edge crosses the screen, with struts down both sides, on its way down. Below the frame, a strip of the dark hangar, then the grey instrument panel as before Play: the gauges, the cassette deck, and the gloved hand on the Play key.
run-start.caption: Level 1 a quarter of a second after Play: the canopy closing over the grey level. Not used in the README.

paused.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern, with a dark translucent panel in the middle. On the panel, "Paused" in large amber pixel letters, and below it a menu: "Resume" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Controls", "Help" and "Quit" in grey. The HUD shows three ship icons, a bomb icon and "x2" in the top left, the score "0002200" in the top right, and the power-up meter along the bottom edge, all six cells dark.
paused.caption: The pause menu over play. Not used in the README.

gameplay.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern. Columns of small square LED segments hang from the top edge and rise from the bottom edge, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, leaving a dark passage across the middle. Two small magenta and amber turrets sit upside down on the tips of the ceiling. A small cyan ship with a magenta engine flame flies on the left, with a row of cyan shots ahead of it. In the middle, a scatter of coloured particles where an enemy was just destroyed, with "200" in white pixel digits above it, and an amber capsule marked "P" falling below it towards the floor; another "200" marks a kill on the right. Three small ship icons on a dark panel in the top left corner show the lives left, followed by a small amber bomb icon and "x2" in amber; "0002200" in white in the top right corner is the score. Along the bottom edge runs the power-up meter, six dark LED cells labelled Boost, Double, Laser, Missile, Drone and Shield.
gameplay.caption: Pattern Break at 21.5 seconds into the test song on normal, with the ship flown by the autopilot.

gameplay-clip.alt: Four seconds of play in an LED cavern. Columns of square LED segments, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, hang from the top and rise from the bottom and scroll from right to left, one column per row of the song. Small magenta and amber turrets ride in on the tips of the floor and ceiling, and small magenta enemy ships fly in from the right and fire round magenta bullets. A small cyan ship on the left keeps firing cyan shots, drops a bomb that bursts on the floor, and moves up and down to dodge. Amber capsules marked "P" rest on the floor bars and scroll away with them. Three ship icons in the top left corner show the lives left, followed by a bomb icon and "x3" in amber, and the score in the top right corner counts up as each kill shows its points where the enemy was. Along the bottom edge runs the power-up meter, six dark LED cells labelled Boost, Double, Laser, Missile, Drone and Shield.
gameplay-clip.caption: Four seconds of the test song on normal, flown by the autopilot through the sim.
